carve_out: Unless the security represents more than 3% of the benchmark, in which case the limit is the benchmark weight plus 2 percentage points.

quote: Aggregate exposure to any single issuer, including all securities of that issuer, shall not exceed 10% of net asset value.
Exposure to the Software sector shall not exceed 40% of net asset value
exposure to the Hardware sector shall not exceed 25% of net asset value.
Exposure to issuers domiciled in Taiwan shall not exceed 15% of net asset value
exposure to issuers domiciled in China shall not exceed 10% of net asset value.
Within the Private and pre-IPO sleeve, no single security shall exceed 5% of net asset value.

No security of an issuer appearing on the Firm's Restricted List may be purchased or added to under any circumstances; this restriction cannot be waived by the Manager, the Chief Investment Officer or Compliance. No exception process exists for it, and no person or committee has authority to override it.
The Fund is required to keep cash and cash equivalents at a level that is never below 1% of net asset value.
At the other end of the range, cash and cash equivalents may not be more than 12% of net asset value.
The Fund must at all times own at least 40 distinct positions, meaning holdings in the securities of different issuers.
Portfolio turnover over any annual measurement period must stay at or below 150% of average net assets.
The Fund's ex-ante tracking error relative to its benchmark index is capped at 800 bps.
The aggregate weight of the Semiconductors sector may not go beyond 35% of net asset value.
Holdings in issuers domiciled in United States may not together account for more than 75% of net asset value.
Issuers involved in the production of controversial weapons (cluster munitions, anti-personnel mines, biological and chemical weapons) are excluded absolutely.
Thermal coal: issuers deriving more than 25% of revenue from thermal coal extraction or thermal coal power generation are excluded.
UN Global Compact: issuers assessed as being in breach of the UN Global Compact principles are excluded.
Exposure to any single securities lending counterparty, and likewise to any single repo counterparty, shall not exceed 15% of net asset value.
No transaction may be entered into with an affiliated entity of the Manager; this conflict-of-interest prohibition cannot be overridden by any individual or committee.
Cash deposits may only be placed with banks rated A- or better.
Any single executing broker shall not account for more than 25% of the Fund's annual traded value.
Scrip dividend: scrip dividend alternatives shall be taken in cash by default.
carve_out: A scrip election is permitted with a documented rationale from the portfolio manager, but is prohibited where the post-election position would exceed the single security limit in the Investment Guidelines.

quote: Rights issue: rights issues shall be taken up by default.
carve_out: Letting rights lapse or selling nil-paid rights is permitted with a documented rationale from the portfolio manager.

quote: Tender offer: tender offers shall be declined by default.
carve_out: Tendering is permitted with the approval of the Chief Investment Officer.

quote: Election deadline: elections shall be instructed to the custodian no later than 2 business days before the custodian deadline.
Holdings classified as illiquid shall not exceed 8% of net asset value
At least 80% of net asset value shall be realisable within five business days under normal market conditions
Swing pricing shall be applied on any dealing day on which net flows exceed 2% of net asset value
No single position shall require more than 5 business days to liquidate at 25% of average daily volume
